title: Alpha5 local-width compression search
research_question: Can Alpha5 preserve its promoted three-head readout while using a narrower local Q.ANT representation?
hypothesis: At least one narrower local width will reduce parameter count by at least 20% relative to Alpha5 while retaining Q.ANT TEST accuracy within one percentage point of the width-16 control and retaining lower mean logit MAE than the historical Alpha4 value from Exp020.
rationale: Alpha5 promoted redundant readout. The next independent architecture dimension is local representation width. Exp005 showed local width is non-monotonic, so the search is deliberately small and preregistered.

frozen_design.readout: three independent Q.ANT Fourier/KAN heads with averaged logits

selection_rule: Among candidates meeting all gates, select the lowest parameter count; ties use higher aggregate Q.ANT correct predictions.
gates: mean Q.ANT accuracy >= alpha5_w16_control mean Q.ANT accuracy - 0.01
mean absolute reference/Q.ANT logit error < 0.03264079298824072 (historical Alpha4 Exp020)
promotion_rule: This experiment selects a compression candidate only. Any selected candidate requires a separate confirmation experiment before replacing Alpha5.
hardware_boundary: Q.ANT CPU/software simulation only; no physical photonic hardware performance claim.
